messages:
Maria G: quick sync — Datadog + OTEL for the HW partner marketplace listing. need to lock sampling + dashboard naming before PR tomorrow.
Jon S: ok. what's the blocker?
Maria G: main thing is trace enrichment for GPU jobs — partner wants span attributes for model_name, seq_len, and quant_profile. also want a small dashboard tile for model-level p50/p95 latency.
Priya K: we already emit model_name in resource attributes, but seq_len and quant_profile are in logs only. can we add them to spans?
Diego R: should be low overhead if we add to start_span metadata. worry about cardinality for quant_profile though. maybe only include quant_profile when it's not default.
Elena P: agreed. i can add a quick rule: include quant_profile tag only when != "fp16". keeps cardinality down.
Jon S: tracing sampling? partner expects 10% traces for continuous logs, but 100% for errors and tail latency. can we support hybrid sampling that routes error spans to full traces?
Maria G: that's the ask. Datadog side recommended `tail_sampling` + local rate limiter. Priya — can you paste the otel config snippet we'll share with partner?
Priya K: sure, pushing small snippet here:
```
service.otel.collector:
  receivers:
    otlp:
      protocols:
        grpc: {}
  processors:
    batch:
    tail_sampling:
      policies:
        - name: error_policy
          type: string_attribute
          string_attribute:
            key: "error"
            values: ["true"]
        - name: high_latency
          type: latency
          latency:
            threshold_ms: 500
  exporters:
    datadog:
      api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}
```
Diego R: looks good. add a small note about tag cardinality and we should document fallback to metric-only aggregation for high-card spans.
Maria G: also need the dashboard tile naming convention for marketplace UI: `Partner / <partner-name> / Model / <model-name> / Latency` — product wants consistency.
Elena P: i'll draft the dashboard JSON and a sample tile. will include p50/p95, error_rate, and inference_qps.
Jon S: can we include an example query for Datadog logs to link traces? e.g., `service:inference AND resource:model_name:resnet50`
Priya K: adding a short snippet for linking logs->trace via trace_id header in logs. recommend `dd.trace_id` field indexed.
Maria G: marketplace listing requires a short ops checklist before submission: 1) telemetry sample config, 2) dashboard JSON, 3) runbook blurb, 4) demo recording link. I'll attach the checklist to the PR.
Diego R: runbook blurb — include guidance for disk usage on GPU nodes (we see /var/log growth when trace sampling is high). add rotate and retention settings.
Elena P: +1. will include `logrotate` example and a retention recommendation: 7 days for detailed traces, 30 days for metrics.
Priya K: scheduling: partner demo is Tue 10am PT. can we do a dry run Mon 4pm PT?
Maria G: dry run works for me. @Jon S @Diego R can you make time?
Jon S: yes, I'll do Mon 4pm.
Diego R: can do.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite sent for 'Datadog + Partner telemetry dry run' Mon 16:00 PT — attendees: Maria G, Jon S, Priya K, Diego R, Elena P.
Maria G: perfect. i'll open the PR after dry run if all good. tagging legal for the joint announcement copy later. :thumbsup:
Jon S: one tiny thing — telemetry QA: can we add a synthetic trace generator to simulate 1k qps with varied seq_len? i have a small tool I can share.
Priya K: that'd be helpful for baseline dashboards. pls drop the repo link in thread.
Jon S: repo: https://git.internal/redwood/telemetry-synth (demo script in `/tools/load_gen`).
Maria G: great. final deliverables: otel config snippet, dashboard JSON, runbook blurb, demo recording link, PR checklist. i'll assign owners in the PR. thanks everyone.
